title: Project-level public large-load and data-center evidence
purpose: Move beyond aggregate source units into individually identifiable projects, permits and named utility-customer records whenever the public evidence exposes a discrete entity, location or regulatory record.
accounting: These records are project/evidence records, not additions to the core 1,558-row table. Multiple dated capacity claims within one project are preserved separately. No MW is inferred from a different unit or missing utility disclosure.
